name: textscan
expr: fname = tempname; fid = fopen(fname, 'w'); fprintf(fid, '1 2 3'); fclose(fid); fid = fopen(fname, 'r'); c = textscan(fid, '%d'); fclose(fid); delete(fname); r1 = double(numel(c{1}));
comment: Side-effect smoke test (file I/O round-trip in single snippet via tempname). textscan returns cell of parsed columns -- 3 elements.
